findings.title: origin/main pushed by an actor outside the build steps
findings.detail: The reflog has a new 'update by push' to 3c88549 at 22:39:15 +07. That was during this reviewer step (bootstrap -Only provision and a log grep), which did not push, and six minutes after the close-out commit. No git alias, hook path, non-sample hook or repo script pushes (the only push strings outside docs/ are github_writer.push_argv and a local fake-fork test). gitleaks is clean on all 61 commits. The owner should identify and stop the auto-push (IDE sync, orchestrator, scheduled task) before the next FEAT. History must not be rewritten.

findings.title: P1-17 linger check skips ossnobody (plan names five service uids)
findings.detail: check_no_user_managers (doctor) and the test_egress_surface.sh loop cover only gatekeeper, ossrunner, ossbox and hermes. Only ossnobody's /run/user/1001 is expected by design (default WSL login). Its Linger=no can still be asserted, and holds live today. Keep the /run/user exemption and add a Linger=no assertion for ossnobody in doctor (test_doctor_users.py) and in the surface test.

findings.title: Draft hold-back assumes a bounded pattern width (carried F005-R1-4)
findings.detail: BA-16 refuses extra_patterns by minimum width only. A whitespace-free pattern with a large maximum width (e.g. x[a-z]{1,1000}y) can show its first len-256 characters in a draft before it matches. The fix is a DESIGN change (also refuse max width >= HOLD_BACK), so the Phase 2 gate should ask the owner first (hard rule 12).

findings.title: squid_drift reads the Hermes login-window state from the conf under test (carried F005-R1-6)
findings.detail: hermes_login is derived from the live squid.conf, so a conf left with the IdC login window open would never count as drift. When FEAT-007 item 35/36 adds the window, compare against the real window state.
